Walk into a bank with $400 to your name
and they'll nickel and dime you into the
ground. Walk in with a hundred grand and
someone offers you coffee and calls you
by your first name. Same bank, same
week. Meet Francine and Seth. Same age,
same job, same paycheck landing in the
same account. The only difference is the
number in savings. Seth gets the
overdraft notices and the polite we
regret to inform you. Francine got
handed a human being who calls himself
her relat
